extDescription.message: Screenshot an element, a region, or the whole page. Works like Firefox Screenshots.

commandVisible.message: Save the visible part of the page

instructions.message: Drag or click on the page to select a region. Press Esc to cancel.

navHint.message: Arrow keys pick the parent, child, or sibling element. Enter selects it.

selectionLabel.message: Selected region. Use arrow keys to move it.

resizeHandleLabel.message: Resize handle. Use arrow keys to resize.

errorClipboardInsecure.message: Copying isn't available on this page because it isn't served over HTTPS. Use Download instead.

errorTabNotActive.message: the tab was switched while capturing

cropped.message: The screenshot was cropped because it was too large. The limit is 32,766 pixels per side and about 125 million pixels in total.

restrictedPage.message: Screenshots aren't allowed on this page

optSmart.message: Smart, like Firefox. Skips headings, prefers articles, and ignores huge wrappers.

optExact.message: Exact. Always starts from the element directly under the pointer.

optSaveAs.message: Ask where to save each screenshot

optFolderHint.message: Leave empty to save straight into Downloads. Example: Screenshots
